messages:
jamal: Quick idea 12:30 rooftop potluck next Tue (May 5)? short + casual, bring something to share. Who's in? :sunny:

priya: love that. i'm in. vegetarian here so will bring a salad.

ben: count me in. can bring iced tea and a portable speaker.

claire: im on a call until 12:30 but can swing by. rain plan?

opsbot: Weather check scheduled for 2026-05-05 09:00. (opsbot)

lunchbot: Poll created: "Date" options: Tue 5/5, Wed 5/6, Thu 5/7 1 vote with :one: :two: :three:. (poll id 9012)

priya: voted :one: (Tue 5/5)

ben: voted :three: (Thu 5/7)

jamal: voted :one: (Tue 5/5)

claire: voted :two: (Wed 5/6)

jamal: @claire rainy-day backup = conference room B2 reserved if forecast > 50% chance of rain.

ben: i'll bring a folding picnic blanket and cups. anyone with allergies? i'll add a signup sheet: https://tiny.redwood/potluck (placeholder)

priya: nuts allergy (peanuts) 1 i'll mark that on the sheet. i'll bring tabbouleh + pita.

claire: can bring disposable plates/utensils and a small first-aid kit.

jamal: perfect. plan: rooftop 12:30, potluck signups on the sheet. if it rains we move to CR B2. ping me if you want me to reserve extra chairs.

opsbot: Reminder set: "Rooftop potluck - confirm headcount" 2026-05-04 10:00

ben: also +1 for sunscreen :sunglasses: and maybe a shade umbrella if someone has one

priya: remote folks? maybe we can send a snack box or share pictures in the channel :laughing:

jamal: good call. we'll set up a phone for a virtual snack corner so remote people can wave in. finalizing after poll closes.
